cases.purpose: Private facility routing, control-byte scrubbing, append and socket mode.
cases.oracle: The original bashsyslogd deferral and documented interface, RFC syslog PRI facility numbers, Linux Unix/UDP datagram and file-link semantics, and the explicit fixture vectors. The independent Python sender and loopback receivers supply exact bytes; timestamp and hostname prefixes are checked as a bounded format using the guest hostname, not matched against candidate-derived expectations.
cases.comparison: The VM-only observer owns its Unix and loopback sockets and daemon. Setup proves Unix empty/nonempty queue ordering, line matcher positive and negative controls, hardlink and symlink behavior, and for config the IPv4/IPv6 loopback and FIFO reader/writer handshake. A SIGHUP reload is synchronized by an observed config FIFO reader before each probe. Original files, bounded raw stdout/stderr, datagrams, process status, comparison details and socket state are captured in the case tree and HOME diagnostic JSONL. Each case compares exact records and explicit normalized results; mismatch or timeout remains failure.
cases.stdout: routing exact=yes mode=0o640 stopped=yes socket-removed=yes stderr-empty=yes
